title: 2027 Seoul Marathon — FAQ for overseas participants
publisher: Seoul Marathon Organizing Committee (The Dong-A Ilbo)
claims: Entry selection is first-come, first-served by payment order; there is no ballot or lottery.
The overseas record submission window runs 1 October 2026 10:00 to 30 November 2026 14:00 KST; runners who miss the window have their registration cancelled.
An entry may not be transferred or resold; a substitute runner's registration is invalid and leads to disqualification.
Race packs are collected at the Seoul Running Expo at DDP; items are not restocked after the expo.
The Gold Package is sold out; no upgrade is offered after purchase, and no additional registration schedule is published.
